observed: Nested italic within bold (**...*อาจ*...**) caused bold regex to fail, leaking literal asterisks into rendered HTML.
rootCause: Rigid [^*]+ pattern in markdown-parser.js bold regex rejected inner asterisks.
remediation: Updated js/core/markdown-parser.js to use non-newline lazy pattern /\*\*([^\n]+?)\*\*/g, enabling clean parsing of nested emphasis.
verification: Re-audit of all 5 domains confirmed 0 unrendered asterisks in visible text.

renderedLocation: Section 5.1.4, symmetric encryption key count formula
observed: Formula was written using LaTeX parenthetical delimiters \(n(n-1)/2\), rendering literally as plain text in the browser.
rootCause: markdown-parser.js only parsed $...$ delimiters for math, ignoring standard LaTeX \(...\) notation.
remediation: Converted formula in domain-5.md to (n - 1) / 2$ and added \(...\) regex parser support in js/core/markdown-parser.js parseInline.
verification: DOM and real Chrome inspection confirmed formula renders as accessible math component.

rootCause: Reading Notes router strictly supports #/reading/domain-X and anchor hashes per Task 143 specification.
verification: 70/70 viewport matrix configurations passed with 42 tables and 28 diagrams rendered live.
